description:
Review point 3 (Low): https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/pull/956#discussion_r4684535686

Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/web_widget_live.ex mount calls capability_snapshot(socket), then reload/2. reload requests :widget_connector_settings from Engine. In lib/zaq/engine/widget_connector_settings.ex, snapshot/2 calls adapter_capabilities/1, which already requests :channel_capability_snapshot with provider web_widget and scope :provider, then discards everything except available?. Extend the settings snapshot to retain the normalized capability result beside the existing adapter availability field. Consume it in WebWidgetLive.apply_snapshot/2 and remove the extra mount lookup. Preserve the existing adapter result contract and configured/unconfigured behavior. Keep failure distinguishable so point 2 can render and retry it; a capability failure must not prevent the rest of settings from loading.

Tests to add before implementation: Add tests in test/zaq/engine/widget_connector_settings_test.exs and test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/web_widget_live_test.exs proving the returned capabilities and availability derive from one capability lookup per settings/mount execution. Account for disconnected and connected LiveView mounts separately. Cover lookup failure, runtime/installation unavailable, zero connectors, and multiple connectors. Preserve test/zaq/engine/widget_connector_settings_coverage_test.exs and adapter enablement contracts; do not silently rewrite exact expected maps.

Branches/paths: normalized success with adapter available/unavailable; Channels failure; settings failure; no selected connector; selected connector; subsequent reload. Mocking: prefer existing isolated fixtures and real domain boundaries. Use existing dispatch observation infrastructure for request counts without creating a parallel production path.

Documentation: Read docs/services/engine.md and docs/services/channels.md; inspect ManageWidgetConnector Action and current public result consumers before extending the snapshot. Read DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md for the LiveView. Update service prose only if the external contract warrants it.

Action reuse assessment: Extend WidgetConnectorSettings.snapshot/2 and adapter_capabilities/1; reuse lib/zaq/engine/actions/manage_widget_connector.ex (ManageWidgetConnector), confidential :widget_connector_settings Event dispatch, Channels.Api :channel_capability_snapshot and Bridge normalization. No new Action is needed: the existing Engine management boundary already owns the allowlisted settings projection. Preserve authorization, existing adapter availability result and secrets exclusion; add only normalized public capability data/status. Inputs and read-only/idempotent behavior stay unchanged. Consumers are existing BO settings and modal; agent/workflow exposure is outside scope.

Acceptance: One underlying capability lookup serves both availability and display per mount/settings execution, normalized metadata is preserved, failure information survives, and existing enablement behavior remains intact. This issue blocks review point 2.

Agent instructions: Fix this issue on the PR #956 lineage after rechecking live code and review state. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/code-quality.md, docs/conventions.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before implementation. Use Serena for code understanding and Context Mode for operational analysis. Read module docs before adding functions. Follow the existing-test-behavior approval gate: add regression tests without changing existing assertions/scenarios; if a change is necessary, disclose the old/new contract and obtain explicit approval first. Keep changes scoped; do not commit, push, merge, reply to reviews, or resolve threads without authorization. Record validation and blockers in this issue. Follow the workflow validation lifecycle; preserve the prior instruction recorded in PR #956 that mix precommit was stopped and not to restart it unless superseded by the user.

comments.text: Live source/callers verified: WidgetConnectorSettings.snapshot already queries Channels; adapter_available is the only other adapter_capabilities caller. ManageWidgetConnector authenticates BO actor and wraps the result transparently. Extend the existing allowlisted snapshot with capabilities: {:ok, normalized_snapshot} | {:error, reason}; derive unchanged adapter result from it. Widget consumes that result without a second mount query. Regression tests reproduced duplicate disconnected mount queries and dropped metadata. Lookup counts use existing Erlang tracing infrastructure because confidential widget events are intentionally excluded from PubSub; no internal stub or production hook added.

Additional live finding: connected apply_snapshot launched refresh_health, which immediately reloaded settings and caused a second capability query. Reuse the initial snapshot in that health refresh; scheduled/manual refreshes still fetch current settings. Count regression now passes for disconnected/connected mounts and reload with zero/two connectors. Engine failure preserves the error while loading settings; availability map and enablement tests unchanged. Initial quality check caught nesting; extracted the existing settings read into a private helper. Final issue-level revalidation in progress.

Issue-level validation passed: mix q clean after local lint fixes; isolated Engine settings, unchanged coverage contracts and widget LiveView tests passed (latest run 52 checks including 1 property). Existing test assertions/scenarios were not edited. Snapshot, availability and display share a lookup, and initial async health refresh reuses it. Implementation prerequisite for zaq-vfx.2 is satisfied; epic retains pending final validation/coverage gates.
